subject: art-design
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Which material is most suitable for bending into a flowing linear 3D form?
questions.explain: Wire is easily bent and twisted, making it ideal for linear, gestural 3D forms.

questions.q: Corrugated card is useful in 3D work because it is...
options: Lightweight, strong and easy to score and fold
questions.explain: Corrugated card is light yet rigid, and can be scored and folded to build 3D forms.

questions.q: Plaster is most commonly used in 3D work for...
options: Casting solid forms in a mould
questions.explain: Plaster is poured into moulds where it sets, making it a common casting material.

questions.q: In 3D design, a 'maquette' or model is made to...
options: Test and plan ideas before making the final piece
questions.explain: A model or maquette lets a designer test scale, form and ideas before committing to the final work.

questions.q: 'Architecture' is a branch of design concerned with...
questions.explain: Architecture is the design of buildings and the spaces people use.

questions.q: Which is an example of three-dimensional design in everyday life?
options: A product such as a chair
questions.explain: Product design, such as a chair, is a form of three-dimensional design.

options: How a form is built and held together to stay stable
questions.explain: Structure concerns how a 3D object is constructed and supported so it stands and holds together.

questions.q: Joining materials together to make a 3D form is called...
questions.explain: Construction (or assembly) builds a 3D form by joining separate pieces together.

questions.q: Which material is shaped while soft and then fired hard in a kiln?
questions.explain: Clay is modelled while soft, then fired in a kiln to become hard and permanent.

questions.q: Which method would a sculptor use to make a hollow form from sheet material?
options: Construction by folding and joining sheets
questions.explain: Folding and joining sheet material is a construction method that can create hollow 3D forms.
